## Summary

Describe the user-visible change and why it is needed.

## Related Issue

Link the Issue for a product-contract change. A small, self-contained correction
may use `Not required`.

## Verification

List the commands and manual checks you ran.

## Submission checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and includes appropriate tests and public documentation.
- [ ] I have the right to submit this work and agree that it is contributed under GitRight's MIT License.
- [ ] I identified any third-party material and confirmed that its license is compatible.
- [ ] The change contains no credentials, private repository content, personal paths, or private host evidence.
